svg.title: dsh-ota-review-check — annotated ledger row
svg.desc: One register row carries the nine canonical columns a rule reads. Each of the seven rules is a dimension line clamped onto the cells its check block names; amber means the severity is capped at warn, blue at info, and the dashed probe marks a rule that cannot run because its vocabulary is empty. Findings leave for issues[] and unrunnable rules for skipped[].

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Source Han Sans SC',sans-serif

svg.text: One ledger row · seven annotations · two outlets

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Source Han Sans SC',sans-serif

svg.text: Each rule is clamped onto the columns of the same row; a rule that cannot run reports itself in skipped — never a silent pass.
